title: Gateway overview
description: Operational monitoring for the media gateway. Provisioned from version-controlled configuration.

panels.title: Service availability
panels.description: Metrics endpoints are reachable. A missing or unavailable target is shown as Unavailable. Check dependency and worker panels for application health.

targets.expr: min by (job) (up{job=~"gateway|worker"}) or label_replace(vector(0), "job", "gateway", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "job", "worker", "", "")

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: Prometheus rules currently firing. Notifications are not configured.

panels.title: Traffic
panels.description: Selected API routes, including polling and rejected requests. Authentication preflights and health probes are excluded.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Approximate 95th percentile HTTP response time. Includes response body delivery; asynchronous generation duration is separate.

panels.title: Dependency availability
panels.description: PostgreSQL ping and Redis queue reads from each application process.

panels.title: Metrics collection
panels.description: An unsuccessful snapshot omits affected backlog values. Missing data is not an empty queue.

panels.title: Active alerts
panels.description: Pending and firing Prometheus alerts. An empty table means there are no active alerts. See the rule guide for thresholds.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx by route
panels.description: An empty graph means no 5xx series has been observed for the selected routes.

panels.title: Active generation tasks
panels.description: Durable queued/running PostgreSQL tasks. Global snapshots use max, not sum across replicas.

panels.title: Task processing delay
panels.description: Oldest overdue scheduled work without a live lease. This differs from total task age.

panels.title: Redis queue entries
panels.description: Pending/claimed/expired delivery entries. Expired is a subset of claimed. These counts differ from durable generation tasks.

panels.title: Oldest active task age
panels.description: Age since admission. Long provider processing can be normal; use overdue processing and alerts to diagnose stalls.

panels.title: Time since successful worker iteration
panels.description: Successful empty-queue iterations also refresh this timestamp.

panels.title: Active worker claims
panels.description: Current provider, polling and archival claim operations.

panels.title: Finished claim operations / second
panels.description: Successful claims can schedule another poll or persist a provider failure. They are not completed generations.

panels.title: Process resident memory
panels.description: Application process memory; host/container metrics are separate.

panels.title: Database pool wait time / second
panels.description: Growth indicates contention for a free application database connection.

options.content:
Choose a time range at the top right. Data is scraped every **15 seconds**; this dashboard refreshes every **30 seconds**. The **Route** filter affects only API traffic and latency panels.

**No data** means measurements are unavailable; check service availability and collectors. Backlogs use **max**, so replicas do not multiply the same jobs. Worker claims are not completed generations. Generation outcomes and billing remain in **Reports**.

Alerts are evaluated by Prometheus. **Pending** is a condition waiting out its delay; **Firing** has passed that delay. Notification delivery is not configured.

[Return to Gateway](/system)

**Initial alert thresholds:** unavailable/missing targets, unavailable dependencies and failed collectors: 1 minute. Stalled worker: expected interval exceeded, then 2 minutes. Task processing delay: above 120 seconds for 5 minutes. Webhook delay: above 300 seconds for 5 minutes. HTTP 5xx: above 5%, at least five errors in the rolling 5-minute window, sustained for 5 minutes.
